author: Clijmart
body:
Yeah yeah, another one...
This time we (Me and DeliciousShoesHD) decided to create a TDM map, which we didn't do before :P

Info: 4 teams, 1 objective: Killing eachother. On this structure map you get your normal loadout gear, with a water bucket!
Images: http://imgur.com/a/S8S5B
YML and Download in Reply beneath!

If you got any feedback, please tell us!
Thanks for reading,
-Clijmart

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
In the future, please use .zip to upload files, as with folders you have to download each item individually.
I've rehosted your map on Dropbox with the proper format. Prune to remove all files except region/level.dat.

I'll XML your map to see if I can get it up with Atlas.

Some changes I recommend:
- 60 players is too many. Make it 6v6v6v6 at most?
- Remove the unnecessary titles for items. It messes up translations.
- Make the diamond axe/pickaxe stone, as they will do immense damage to players in current condition.
- Remove the enchantments that make the tools seem like they slice through butter (dig speed 5.)

Otherwise, I'll test it out. Good map!
